metadata.description: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌（Logo / 名称 / 中央标题 / favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。Rebrand your DSH web UI and stamp "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.
metadata.name: dsh-brand-text

paragraphs.text: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌（Logo / 名称 / 中央标题 / favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。Rebrand your DSH web UI a
nd stamp "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.
# dsh-brand-text
**English** | 中文
Branding for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web** client, in **two layers**:
1. **Basics** — sidebar logo, sidebar name, the hero title in the middle of an empty conversation, b

rowser tab title, favicon and PWA manifest.
2. **Watermark** — a translucent, opacity-tunable overla
y on the page, **plus** a stamping ledger that writes *“why this was added”* and *“what job was runn
ing”* into the project files and folders DSH works on.
Both layers are edited from one settings panel (`/brand-studio/`) or by double-clicking in place, an
d both live in the same `brand.json`.

> ⚠ Not the same as the community plugin `dsh-custom-brand`.
> Both occupy the sidebar brand slots,
so **do not enable them together** — they fight over the same DOM.
## ① Basics — what you can change
| Item | Where it shows | Data key |
| Sidebar name | Top-left of the sidebar; also the browser tab title and PWA name | `productName` |
| Hero title | The line in the middle of an empty new conversation | `heroText` (empty = official de

fault "Into the Unknown" / 「探索未至之境」) |
| Sidebar logo | Sidebar brand slot / favicon / PWA icon | `l

o the Unknown" / 「探索未至之境」) |
| Sidebar logo | Sidebar brand slot / favicon / PWA icon | `logoPath` |
Changes take effect on a **page refresh (F5)** — no DSH restart required.
This plugin also covers everything the community plugin `dsh-client-ui-brand` did (title / brand slo

ts / favicon / manifest),
so you do **not** need to install that one.
## ② Watermark — why bother doing it inside DSH
The obvious use is stamping photos. The less obvious one is the reason this lives in DSH:
> You add a pile of project files/folders while working on something. Two weeks later you open them

again and
> have no idea **why they were added** or **what job you were in the middle of**.
So the watermark stores two sentences — *why this was added* and *what is being worked on* — and sho
ws them in two places:
| Form | Where you see it | Notes |
| **A. Page overlay** | A translucent diagonal text layer over DSH | opacity / angle / size / tiled-

or-single are all tunable; `pointer-events: none`, so it never blocks clicks |
| **B. File / folder
stamp** | Inside the project directory — a `_DSH水印说明.md` note, an Explorer hover tip (InfoTip), and
folder icon swapped to the brand mark | Written to the folder itself, so it survives outside DSH |
Stamps are tracked in a **ledger** (`watermark.targets`) with an *apply* / *undo* button per path. U

ndo removes the note,
restores the previous `desktop.ini`, and clears the folder attribute.

> Windows only for form B (it relies on `desktop.ini` + `attrib`). Form A works on any browser.
> Ap
plying a stamp sets the **system** attribute on the target folder — that is how Explorer is told to

read `desktop.ini`.
> Explorer may need F5 to pick it up.

## Two ways to edit (same data, same API)
| Way | How | Good for |
| **Settings panel** | `http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-port>/brand-studio/` | Everything: basics, watermark t

uning with a live preview, and the file/folder ledger |
| **Double-click in place** | Double-click t
he **top-left brand area** (logo or text) for a quick dialog; double-click the **hero line** to edit
that copy | Quick tweaks — the page reloads after saving |
The dialog keeps the same order as the panel: **① basics first** (name, hero title, logo), **② water

mark after it**
(enable switch, watermark text, *what job is running*, opacity slider).
> Trade-off: the sidebar brand area is normally a "new conversation" button, and a double-click woul

d fire two clicks.
> To make double-click usable, the plugin swallows `click` / `pointerdown` on the

brand slots —
> **a single click no longer starts a new conversation**; double-click edits, right-c
lick opens the full panel.

**Recommended order: npm first (prebuilt, no pnpm build) → GitHub → local copy as the fallback.**

`install.mjs` is idempotent: it writes a `link:` dependency, adds the plugin to `bundles`,
then runs

`pnpm install`. Run it as often as you like.
Local installs pick up your edits immediately (no rein
stall needed after changing `lib/`).
Manual equivalent, inside the target profile:

1. add `"dsh-brand-text": "link:<absolute path to this plugin>"` to `dependencies`
2. add `"dsh-bran

d-text"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` in the profile director

-text"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` in the profile directory
## Compatibility

- Host: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.x (developed and verified on `0.2.1-alpha.4`).
- Uses three slots: `s

idebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`, `conversation.hero.brand.mark`,
plus `webserver/index-inje

ct` and the `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle format (same as official client plugins).
- Folder stam
ping is Windows-only and degrades quietly: if `attrib` is unavailable the note file is still written

.
- If branding stops working after a DSH upgrade: check `logs/dsh.log` for `dsh-brand-text` errors,
then confirm the plugin is still listed in the profile's `bundles`.
